notes.executionPlanDone: The chapter's execution plan is complete.
notes.executionPlanPending: The chapter lacks an execution plan; the system will prepare a task sheet or scene breakdown.
notes.writingInProgress: AI is writing this chapter's content.
notes.writingPending: There's an execution plan; you can start writing.
notes.reviewInProgress: Content is generated and the system is reviewing it.
notes.reviewPending: The chapter has content; the next step is review.
notes.repairInProgress: The system is fixing the content per the issues found.
notes.repairPending: If review finds issues, the chapter enters the repair stage.
notes.stateSyncInProgress: The content is readable; the system is syncing state, character changes and key resources.
notes.stateSyncPending: Once the content is ready, the system syncs state and key resources.
notes.payoffSyncInProgress: The system is calibrating the chapter's payoff ledger.
notes.payoffSyncPending: After resource sync, the system calibrates the payoff ledger by risk and rhythm.
notes.readyDone: The chapter has reached a continuable state.
notes.readyInProgress: The chapter has finished the current review round; you can keep editing or address suggestions.
notes.readyPending: Finish the earlier steps to continue this chapter.

primary.selectChapterReason: Select the chapter to work on at left; the system determines the next step.
primary.openEditorReason: The chapter has content. Open the editor, or make a quick edit below.
primary.openEditorExistingReason: The chapter has content; opening the editor is more efficient for fine-tuning.
primary.fullAuditReason: Content exists; run a full audit before repairing or rewriting.
primary.createPlanReason: The chapter lacks goals or a task sheet; fill in the plan first.
primary.writeChapterReason: Preparation info is sufficient; the best next step is to generate the chapter content.

strategy.hint: Keep defaults when unsure. Adjust only when the chapter needs a faster pace, stronger conflict or more AI freedom.
strategy.apply: Apply the strategy to the current chapter

unplanned.label: Pending prep
unplanned.description: Pending prep: the chapter lacks execution resources.

pendingGeneration.label: Pending write
pendingGeneration.description: Pending write: the chapter plan is largely complete.

generating.label: Writing
generating.description: Writing: AI is generating the chapter content.

pendingReview.label: Reviewed
pendingReview.description: Reviewed: you can view suggestions or keep editing.

needsRepair.label: Repair suggested
needsRepair.description: Repair suggested: review found issues, but editing isn't blocked.

completed.label: Completed
completed.description: Completed: the chapter passed the current flow.

unset.label: Not set
unset.description: Not set: the chapter has no clear flow status yet.

planned.label: In the table of contents
planned.description: The chapter is in the ToC but has no draft yet.

drafted.label: Drafted
drafted.description: There's a draft but review isn't confirmed.

approved.label: Approved
approved.description: The chapter passed the quality threshold.

published.label: Published
published.description: The chapter is in a published state.

queuePreview.sceneBudgetContract: The chapter has a scene budget contract.
queuePreview.legacySceneCards: The chapter has a legacy scene breakdown; regenerate it.
queuePreview.noObjective: The chapter has no clear goal; add a plan.
